tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Search all approved catalog products using a shopping description and optional requirements. Matches use attributed listing facts; unknown constraints are never confirmed. Use prepare_checkout to request a seller route. Synthetic test data is explicitly labeled.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Inspect the requested product facts, seller claims, price, measurements, source evidence and photographs. Use prepare_checkout to request a seller route. Unknown IDs return not_found; no private records are exposed.

tools.name: ask_seller
tools.description: Ask a bounded product question using its item_id, or submit structured shopping requirements. With multiple items, item-specific questions require an item_id; none is assumed. tools.name: prepare_checkout
tools.description: Record explicit purchase intent for one unit of a catalog item. When enabled and approved, return the seller checkout link. Obtain buyer approval before proceeding. This creates no order or payment and does not verify checkout was reached.
